public_last_ticker.scope: Shape evidence only. No wallet authorization, private request, placement, trigger or fill is proved.

native_testing: Paused at user request. No device tools, device tests or APK installation. See ../native-verification-pending.md.
ios: Linux has no macOS/Xcode; build and native flows unverified.
implementation: Immutable independent trigger terms derive STOP/TAKE_PROFIT/STOP_MARKET/TAKE_PROFIT_MARKET; symbol orderTypes and protection threshold validated at the data boundary.

Last and Mark stay distinct. Optional public Last ticker failure does not block ordinary orders or silently substitute a reference. Last trade timestamp can be old in a quiet market; future timestamps and invalid prices fail validation.

Trigger side, Decimal price bounds/ticks, supported type, known protection threshold and already-met trigger checks gate review. General LOT_SIZE applies to conditional quantity; ordinary MARKET retains MARKET_LOT_SIZE. Aster checks actual trigger-time eligibility.

Conditional limit execution price is not blocked using current mark PERCENT_PRICE; exchange placement/trigger checks remain authoritative. Conditional estimates use trigger/limit reference with explicit limitations.
Position TP/SL route preserves symbol/position side and fixed conditional mode; explicit preflight and independent position recheck precede POST. No extra wallet or extra signatures.

POST ACK is not execution proof. Independent GET validates origType, trigger price, basis, protection, reduction flags, quantity and applicable limit policy, allowing corresponding LIMIT/MARKET type after trigger.

Unknown results preserve ID and frozen condition; GET-only recovery never repeats POST. Input survives cancel/refresh, missing references require explicit choice, dormant trigger terms are omitted from ordinary orders.
evidence: Full suite covers existing wallet, account, policy, close/batch, market and localization regressions.
boundaries: Each submission creates one specified-quantity conditional order. Independent TP and SL orders do not automatically cancel each other and are not represented as OCO.
Entire close closePosition=true, PnL/ROI input conversion and attached TP/SL/linkage/editing remain incomplete. BBO, trailing/Chase and chart quick opening also remain in PRD scope.
Trigger protection can delay/prevent triggering; it is not execution-price protection.
Current position, leverage and funds can change before triggering; reference PnL/margin excludes fees, funding, slippage and execution-time rules.
Aster enable-trading and acceptance of the selected EOA as its own API signer remain unverified.
Other remaining scope includes subaccounts, funding/withdrawals/transfers, valuation, notifications and cross-process unresolved-order recovery.
BAPI historical statistics and TWAP skipped this phase at user request.
